tasks.label: Gerar htpasswd
args: $P=((Get-Location).Path -replace '\\','/'); if(!(Test-Path 'nginx')){ New-Item -ItemType Directory nginx | Out-Null }; docker run --rm -v "$P/nginx:/out" alpine sh -lc "apk add --no-cache apache2-utils >/dev/null && htpasswd -nbB uploader 'vmx30032' > /out/htpasswd && cat /out/htpasswd"
